title: HtmlInputRadio
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type radio without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputRadio.children
inputs.description: The optional children prop is a Svelte Snippet that the component destructures out of its props, so it is never spread onto the input element. The component never renders it, so passing it has no effect on the output.

outputs.name: HtmlInputRadio
outputs.description: The native input element that svelte:element renders with this set to 'input', with every prop except children spread onto it and then type set to 'radio', so any type prop is overridden. The component adds no wrapper element around it and renders no child content.
